scope: Floating transcript polling and authoritative desktop caption cache reads; no new model or native release build.

floating.projection: Floating replies exclude notes and suggestions. Original-text mode uses session/view/meeting/SQLite revision; changed content returns the projected saved transcript. Translation enabled still checks receipts on every full refresh.
floating.browser: Mounted real production module in Chromium with controlled native IPC. Runtime deltas preserve 5,000 saved row nodes, text selection and scroll position; only current partial/clock/status changes. Search/locale are local, corrections and revoked translations repaint. Audio and old responses cannot cross a selection.
floating.slow_requests: Review found resets could queue more native calls. Fixed to one in-flight request plus one coalesced latest-scope poll. 25 meeting switches while an unresolved request is held issue zero additional requests, then exactly one request for the final selection.

captions.correctness: Desktop overlay uses the same current source, terminology and runtime provenance as main transcript. Note term edits, source/revision changes and missing runtime reject stale generated text and retain current source. Literal legacy caches retain current-name checks. Empty or deleted selections cannot show another meeting partial.
captions.scheduling: One in-flight blocking lookup away from UI thread. Native render verifies current meeting/mode and observed selection generation; changed selection clears the previous frame.

limits: Payload sizes and bounded-query controls do not establish whole-app CPU, latency, memory or energy improvements.
Translation-enabled floating refreshes still carry all transcript rows. Initial transcript history remains fully rendered.

Actual matching literal captions still build current terminology from history. Cold or changed source-context receipts may scan source context once. Only unchanged generated-caption cache reads avoid this repeated materialization.
Chromium IPC is mocked. Native caption scheduling tests cover the state machine; this batch does not qualify installed native UI, GPU execution or package upgrades.

CUDA/Vulkan packaging and hardware recommendation code are unchanged. Existing signed optional archives remain separate. Real-device acceptance, Q9 and Q16 remain open; stable release is v0.3.4 and v0.3.5 is not published.
